title: Tobacco products; possession or consumption prohibited.
bodyText: Possession or consumption of a tobacco product by a person under twenty-one years of age in a public place shall be prohibited.
bodyHtml: [§321-212]  Tobacco products; possession or consumption prohibited.  Possession or consumption of a tobacco product by a person under twenty-one years of age in a public place shall be prohibited. [L 2015, c 122, pt of §2]
